nom: Olay Super Cream with Sunscreen SPF 30

segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin report the cream is moisturizing and helps flaky, dry patches, including one with dry, mature skin who calls it a big bonus; one reviewer with very dry and sensitive skin, however, found the hydration wore off within two hours and the cream made her skin itchy.
segments.sensitive: Most sensitive-skin reviewers report no irritation and comfortable daily wear, though several separately report the cream stings or burns if it gets into the eyes, and one with dry, sensitive skin reacted with itchiness and short-lived hydration.
segments.normal: One reviewer describes the cream as ideal for normal to dry skin, delivering hydration and sun protection in one step.
segments.mature: Reviewers with mature or aging skin, including one with dry mature skin and another in her 40s who had given up on other Olay moisturizers, report it finally delivers noticeable hydration and improvement where other creams had failed or irritated their skin.

concerns.aging: Reviewers using the cream against fine lines and loss of firmness report smoother, tighter-feeling skin, a brighter complexion and better elasticity, in some cases noticeable within the first week.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers report lasting hydration and softer, smoother skin through the day; one reviewer with dry, sensitive skin instead found the hydration wore off within two hours and the cream left her skin itchy.

aspects.libelle: Stings or burns if it gets in the eyes
Small container size can feel overpriced
Distinct sunscreen scent on the regular version
Velvety, whipped texture that absorbs without white cast
Works well as a makeup primer or base

extraits.titre: It did not work for my dry and sensitive skin
extraits.texte: I am glad I tried this cream on my day off, because I ended up washing my face. I have very dry and sensitive skin. This cream made my skin itchy, and the hydration did not last for more than two hours. I reapplied it a few more times throughout the day to give it a chance, but I gave up and washed my face and used my ice roller to calm my skin. I don't know what ingredient caused the itchiness, but it felt awful. Also, if it gets in the eyes, it burns really bad.

I’m torn. One of the very few products I have that doesn’t burn my eyes is my Olay super serum. I have very fair sensitive skin and I struggle to find sunscreen that doesn’t burn. So I was excited to try this. However, it does burn my eyes. And when I first put it on it burns my whole face a little. But it calms down quickly. Great texture and easy to rub in. But yeah, just not hitting the mark for me to want to buy it again is all.

extraits.titre: Good texture, absorbed well by my skin
extraits.texte: I've been using Olay face cream for more than 3 years now (have very dry mature skin) & this Olay Super cream with SPF 30 is a big bonus because summer is coming. Love the texture of the cream & smell good too. I recommend to try it !!

extraits.titre: Effective and worth the affordable price tag
extraits.texte: I picked up a tiny bottle of the Olay Super Cream (the size of Clinique free w/purchase) and figured it was worth trying. I’m so glad that I did! It works extremely well. My skin is hydrated and looks great. I love that it has sunscreen included. The texture feels as though it is a whipped cream. It is not super heavy and not greasy. I’m getting older and regular daily Oil of Olay moisturizer was not doing anything for me anymore. It simply was not hydrating my skin. I’ve tried other moisturizers in the past and have had problems with all of them. Clinique moisturizers caused my skin to break out. Olay Regenerist made my skin feel as though it was on fire. It’s taken me a long time to find a moisturizer that works, feels good, and does not burn my skin. This one is the one I’ve been looking for. I find it effective and worth the affordable price tag. For reference, I’m in my 40’s, have very fair skin and freckles.

extraits.titre: Feels very light, moisturizing, SPF, reducing fine line!
extraits.texte: This super cream from Olay is perfect! The cream works as a daily moisturizer and SPF at the same time. It has a great texture that feels very light on the skin. It doesn’t feel heavy at all and it is very easily absorbed. I used the cream for three days now and I already feel my face is softer with almost no effort. I only use facial wash then apply this cream anyway even if I am not planning to leave the house this day. The cream is very soft. It also helps reduce the fine lines although I still haven’t seen this yet on my skin but I think it might on the long term since I already feel my skin a little tighter after applying it. Overall I am so happy with it and I recommend it.

The Olay Super Cream with SPF 30 is fantastic! It’s lightweight, fragrance-free, and absorbs quickly without leaving a greasy residue. I love that it combines hydration, brightening, firming, and sun protection in one step, makes my morning routine so easy. The addition of Niacinamide, Vitamin C, and Collagen makes my skin feel nourished and healthier over time. My face looks brighter, feels soft, and has better elasticity since I started using it. Perfect for daily use, especially if you want a simple, effective all-in-one moisturizer with sun protection.

Im no specialist on using skin creams or lotions but this out of the box am suprized. Packaged and labeled well and a very thick creamy structure it doesnt take alot as i learned the hard way first time. Use to much and its a bit greasy feeling but thats expected till it absorbs. As far as washing off it doesnt come off instantly which is a plus especially if using as a sun protectant. Works good for dry skin as well or flaky skin.
